150.m: Sarvatraga and others [will be his sons]. The Manu named Rudrasāvarṇi will come; / Ṛtadhāman will be the ruler of the gods, and the Haritas and others the deities;

150.s:
tapasyādyāḥ saptarṣayaḥ sutā vaidevavanmukhāḥ /
manustrayodaśo raucyaḥ sūtrāmāṇādayaḥ surāḥ //
150.d:
तपस्याद्याः सप्तर्षयः सुता वैदेववन्मुखाः /
मनुस्त्रयोदशो रौच्यः सूत्रामाणादयः सुराः //
150.m: Tapasvin and others will be the seven seers; the sons will be headed by Devavat. / The thirteenth Manu will be Raucya; the Sūtrāmans and others will be the gods;

150.s:
indro divaspatisteṣāṃ dānavādivimardanaḥ /
nirmohādyāḥ saptarṣayaścitrasenādayaḥ sutāḥ //
150.d:
इन्द्रो दिवस्पतिस्तेषां दानवादिविमर्दनः /
निर्मोहाद्याः सप्तर्षयश्चित्रसेनादयः सुताः //
150.m: their Indra will be Divaspati, the crusher of Dānavas and others; / Nirmoha and others will be the seven seers, and Citrasena and others his sons.

150.s:
manuś caturdaśo bhautyaḥ śucirindro bhaviṣyati /
cākṣuṣādyāḥ suragaṇā agnibāhṇādayo dvijāḥ //
150.d:
मनुश् चतुर्दशो भौत्यः शुचिरिन्द्रो भविष्यति /
चाक्षुषाद्याः सुरगणा अग्निबाह्णादयो द्विजाः //
150.m: The fourteenth Manu will be Bhautya; Śuci will be Indra; / the Cākṣuṣas and others will be the classes of gods; Agnibāhu and others the twice-born seers;

150.s:
caturdaśasya bhautyasya putrā ūrumukhā manoḥ /
prayartayanti devāṃś ca bhuvi saptarṣayo divaḥ //
150.d:
चतुर्दशस्य भौत्यस्य पुत्रा ऊरुमुखा मनोः /
प्रयर्तयन्ति देवांश् च भुवि सप्तर्षयो दिवः //
150.m: the sons of the fourteenth Manu, Bhautya, will be headed by Ūru. / The seven seers in heaven bring forth the gods on earth.

150.s:
devā yajñabhujaste tu bhūḥ putraiḥ paripālyate /
brahmaṇo divase brahmanmanavastu caturdaśa //
150.d:
देवा यज्ञभुजस्ते तु भूः पुत्रैः परिपाल्यते /
ब्रह्मणो दिवसे ब्रह्मन्मनवस्तु चतुर्दश //
150.m: Those gods are the consumers of the sacrifice, while the earth is protected by the sons. / In a day of Brahmā, O Brahmin, there are fourteen Manus.

150.s:
manvādyāś ca harirvedaṃ dvāparānte vibheda saḥ /
ādyo vedaś catuṣpādaḥ śatasāhasrasammitaḥ //
150.d:
मन्वाद्याश् च हरिर्वेदं द्वापरान्ते विभेद सः /
आद्यो वेदश् चतुष्पादः शतसाहस्रसम्मितः //
150.m: The Manus and others [reign], and Hari divided the Veda at the end of the Dvāpara age. / The original Veda had four quarters, measuring a hundred thousand [verses].

150.s:
ekaścāsīd yajurvedastaṃ caturdhā vyakalpayat /
ādhvaryavaṃ yajurbhistu ṛgbhirhotraṃ tathā muniḥ //
150.d:
एकश्चासीद् यजुर्वेदस्तं चतुर्धा व्यकल्पयत् /
आध्वर्यवं यजुर्भिस्तु ऋग्भिर्होत्रं तथा मुनिः //
150.m: And the Yajurveda was one; he arranged it into four parts. / The sage [constituted] the duty of the adhvaryu priest with the Yajuses, and that of the hotṛ priest with the Ṛcs;

150.s:
audgātraṃ sāmabhioś cakre brahmatvañcāpyatharvabhiḥ /
prathamaṃ vyāsaśiṣyastu pailo hy ṛgvedapāragaḥ //
150.d:
औद्गात्रं सामभिओश् चक्रे ब्रह्मत्वञ्चाप्यथर्वभिः /
प्रथमं व्यासशिष्यस्तु पैलो ह्य् ऋग्वेदपारगः //
150.m: the duty of the udgātṛ priest he made with the Sāmans, and the office of the brahman priest with the Atharvans. / First, Paila, a disciple of Vyāsa, was master of the Ṛgveda;

150.s:
indraḥ pramataye prādādvāskalāya ca saṃhitāṃ /
baudhyādibhyo dadau sopi caturdhā nijasaṃhitāṃ //
:p 116
150.d:
इन्द्रः प्रमतये प्रादाद्वास्कलाय च संहितां /
बौध्यादिभ्यो ददौ सोपि चतुर्धा निजसंहितां //
:प् 116
150.m:
he gave the collection to Indrapramati and to Bāṣkala. / He too gave his own collection fourfold to Baudhya and others.
[p. 116]

150.s:
yajurvedataroḥ śākhāḥ saptaviṃśanmahāmatiḥ /
vaiśampāyananāmāsau vyāsaśiṣyaś cakāra vai //
150.d:
यजुर्वेदतरोः शाखाः सप्तविंशन्महामतिः /
वैशम्पायननामासौ व्यासशिष्यश् चकार वै //
150.m: That highly intelligent disciple of Vyāsa, named Vaiśampāyana, / made twenty-seven branches of the tree of the Yajurveda.

150.s:
kāṇvā vājasaneyādyā yājñavalkyādibhiḥ smṛtāḥ /
sāmavedataroḥ śākhā vyāsaśiṣyaḥ sajaiminiḥ //
150.d:
काण्वा वाजसनेयाद्या याज्ञवल्क्यादिभिः स्मृताः /
सामवेदतरोः शाखा व्यासशिष्यः सजैमिनिः //
150.m: The Kāṇvas, the Vājasaneyas, and others are remembered [as taught] by Yājñavalkya and others. / The disciple of Vyāsa, Jaimini, [arranged] the branches of the tree of the Sāmaveda.

150.s:
sumantuś ca sukarmā ca ekaikāṃ saṃhitāṃ tataḥ /
gṛhṇate ca sukarmākhyaḥ sahasraṃ saṃhitāṃ guruḥ //
150.d:
सुमन्तुश् च सुकर्मा च एकैकां संहितां ततः /
गृह्णते च सुकर्माख्यः सहस्रं संहितां गुरुः //
150.m: Then Sumantu and Sukarman each received one collection. / The teacher named Sukarman [divided] the collection into a thousand.

150.s:
sumantuścātharvataruṃ vyāsaśiṣyo vibheda taṃ /
śiṣyānadhyāpayāmāsa paipyalādān sahasraśaḥ //
150.d:
सुमन्तुश्चाथर्वतरुं व्यासशिष्यो विभेद तं /
शिष्यानध्यापयामास पैप्यलादान् सहस्रशः //
150.m: And Sumantu, a disciple of Vyāsa, divided the tree of the Atharvaveda; / he taught disciples by the thousands, [such as] the Paippalādas.

150.s:
purāṇasaṃhitāṃ cakre suto vyāsaprasādataḥ //31//
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe manvantarāṇi nāma
pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athaikapañcāśadadhikaśatatano 'dhyāyaḥ
varṇetaradharmāḥ
150.d:
पुराणसंहितां चक्रे सुतो व्यासप्रसादतः //31//
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे मन्वन्तराणि नाम
पञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथैकपञ्चाशदधिकशततनो ऽध्यायः
वर्णेतरधर्माः
150.m:
Sūta composed the Purāṇa collection through the grace of Vyāsa.
Thus ends the one hundred and fiftieth chapter, entitled 'The Cosmic Eras of the Manus', in the Great Agni Purāṇa.
Now begins the one hundred and fifty-first chapter.
[Duties beyond caste]

151.s:
agnir uvāca
manvādayo bhuktimuktidharmāṃścīrtvāpnuvanti yān /
proce paraśurāmāya varuṇoktantu puṣkaraḥ //
151.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
मन्वादयो भुक्तिमुक्तिधर्मांश्चीर्त्वाप्नुवन्ति यान् /
प्रोचे परशुरामाय वरुणोक्तन्तु पुष्करः //
151.m: Agni said: / Puṣkara spoke to Paraśurāma that which was declared by Varuṇa, / the duties of worldly enjoyment and liberation, practising which Manu and others attain [their goals].

151.s:
puṣkara uvāca
varṇāśrametarāṇānte dharmānvakṣyāmi sarvadān /
manvādibhir nigaditān vāsudevādituṣṭidān //
:p 117
151.d:
पुष्कर उवाच
वर्णाश्रमेतराणान्ते धर्मान्वक्ष्यामि सर्वदान् /
मन्वादिभिर् निगदितान् वासुदेवादितुष्टिदान् //
:प् 117
151.m:
Puṣkara said: / I will declare to you the all-granting duties common to all castes and stages of life, / proclaimed by Manu and others, which grant satisfaction to Vāsudeva and others:
[p. 117]

151.s:
ahiṃsā satyavacanandayā bhūteṣvanugrahaḥ /
tīrthānusaraṇaṃ dānaṃ brahmacaryammatsaraḥ //
151.d:
अहिंसा सत्यवचनन्दया भूतेष्वनुग्रहः /
तीर्थानुसरणं दानं ब्रह्मचर्यम्मत्सरः //
151.m: non-violence, truthful speech, compassion, kindness to living beings, / visiting sacred fords, generosity, celibacy, absence of malice,

151.s:
devadvijātiśuśrūṣā gurūṇāñca bhṛgūttama /
śravaṇaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā //
151.d:
देवद्विजातिशुश्रूषा गुरूणाञ्च भृगूत्तम /
श्रवणं सर्वधर्माणां पितॄणां पूजनं तथा //
151.m: service to gods and twice-born persons, and of gurus, O best of the Bhṛgus, / listening to all duties, and likewise the worship of the ancestors,

151.s:
bhaktiś ca nṛpatau nityaṃ tathā sacchāstranetratā /
ānṛśaṃṣyantitikṣā ca tathā cāstikyameva ca //
151.d:
भक्तिश् च नृपतौ नित्यं तथा सच्छास्त्रनेत्रता /
आनृशंष्यन्तितिक्षा च तथा चास्तिक्यमेव च //
151.m: constant devotion to the king, and viewing things through the excellent scriptures, / non-cruelty, endurance, and firm faith.

151.s:
varṇāśramāṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ dharmādharmaṃ(1) samīritaṃ /
yajanaṃ yājanaṃ dānaṃ vedādyadhyāpanakriyā //
151.d:
वर्णाश्रमाणां सामान्यं धर्माधर्मं(1) समीरितं /
यजनं याजनं दानं वेदाद्यध्यापनक्रिया //
151.m: The common duty and non-duty of the castes and stages of life has been declared. / Sacrificing for oneself, officiating at sacrifices for others, giving gifts, teaching the Vedas and other texts,

151.s:
pratigrahañcādhyayanaṃ viprakarmāṇi nirdiśet /
dānamadhyayanañcaiva yajanañca yathāvidhiḥ //
151.d:
प्रतिग्रहञ्चाध्ययनं विप्रकर्माणि निर्दिशेत् /
दानमध्ययनञ्चैव यजनञ्च यथाविधिः //
151.m: receiving gifts, and studying: these are prescribed as the activities of a Brahmin. / Giving gifts, studying, and sacrificing in accordance with the rule:

151.s:
kṣatriyasya savaiśyasya karmedaṃ parikīrtitaṃ /
kṣatriyasya viśeṣeṇa pālanaṃ duṣṭanigrahaḥ //
151.d:
क्षत्रियस्य सवैश्यस्य कर्मेदं परिकीर्तितं /
क्षत्रियस्य विशेषेण पालनं दुष्टनिग्रहः //
151.m: this duty is proclaimed for the Kṣatriya and the Vaiśya. / For the Kṣatriya in particular, [his duty is] protection and punishing the wicked.

151.s:
kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyasya parikīrtitaṃ /
śūdrasya dvijaśuśrūṣā sarvaśilpāni vāpyatha //
151.d:
कृषिगोरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यस्य परिकीर्तितं /
शूद्रस्य द्विजशुश्रूषा सर्वशिल्पानि वाप्यथ //
151.m: Agriculture, cattle rearing, and trade are proclaimed for the Vaiśya. / For the Śūdra, service to the twice-born, or all craft traditions.

151.s:
mauñjībandhanato janma viprādeś ca dvitīyakaṃ /
ānulomyena varṇānāṃ jātirmātṛsamā smṛtā //
151.d:
मौञ्जीबन्धनतो जन्म विप्रादेश् च द्वितीयकं /
आनुलोम्येन वर्णानां जातिर्मातृसमा स्मृता //
151.m: From the tying of the muñja grass cord comes the second birth of the Brahmin and others. / In the natural order of the castes, the offspring is remembered to be equal to the mother.

151.s:
caṇḍālo brāhmaṇīputraḥ śūdrācca pratilomataḥ /
sūtastu kṣatriyājjāto vaiśyādvai devalas tathā //
151.d:
चण्डालो ब्राह्मणीपुत्रः शूद्राच्च प्रतिलोमतः /
सूतस्तु क्षत्रियाज्जातो वैश्याद्वै देवलस् तथा //
151.m: A Caṇḍāla is born against the natural order from a Śūdra by a Brahmin woman; / a Sūta is born from a Kṣatriya woman, and a Devala from a Vaiśya woman;

151.s:
pukkasaḥ kṣatriyāputraḥ śūdrāt syāt pratilomajaḥ /
māgadhaḥ syāttathā vaiśyācchūdrādayogavo bhavet //
151.d:
पुक्कसः क्षत्रियापुत्रः शूद्रात् स्यात् प्रतिलोमजः /
मागधः स्यात्तथा वैश्याच्छूद्रादयोगवो भवेत् //
151.m: a Pukkasa is born against the order from a Śūdra by a Kṣatriya woman; / a Māgadha from a Vaiśya woman, and an Āyogava from a Śūdra woman.

151.s:
vaiśyāyāṃ pratilomebhyaḥ pratilomāḥ sahasraśaḥ /
:n
1 dharmarūpamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca
:p 118
vivāhaḥ sadṛśaisteṣāṃ nottamair nādhamais tathā //
151.d:
वैश्यायां प्रतिलोमेभ्यः प्रतिलोमाः सहस्रशः /
:न्
1 धर्मरूपमिति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 118
विवाहः सदृशैस्तेषां नोत्तमैर् नाधमैस् तथा //
151.m:
Through unions against the natural order with a Vaiśya woman, thousands of mixed castes against the natural order arise.
[Note]
1. ga, gha, ṅa, and ña read: 'dharmarūpam'. / [p. 118]
Their marriage is with their equals, not with those higher, nor with those lower.

151.s:
caṇḍālakarma nirdiṣṭaṃ badhyānāṃ ghātanaṃ tathā /
strījīvantu tadrakṣāproktaṃ(1) vaidehakasya ca //
151.d:
चण्डालकर्म निर्दिष्टं बध्यानां घातनं तथा /
स्त्रीजीवन्तु तद्रक्षाप्रोक्तं(1) वैदेहकस्य च //
151.m: The duty of a caṇḍāla is prescribed as the execution of those condemned to death. / The duty of a Vaidehaka is declared to be living off women and guarding them.

151.s:
sūtānāmaśvasārathyaṃ pukkasānāñca vyādhatā /
stutikriyā māghdhānāṃ tathā cāyogaśasya ca //
151.d:
सूतानामश्वसारथ्यं पुक्कसानाञ्च व्याधता /
स्तुतिक्रिया माघ्धानां तथा चायोगशस्य च //
151.m: For Sūtas, driving horses and chariots; for Pukkasas, hunting; / for Māgadhas, the act of singing praises; and likewise for an Āyogava,

151.s:
raṅgāvataraṇaṃ proktaṃ tathā śilpaiś ca jīvanaṃ /
vahirgrāmanivāsaś ca mṛtacelasya dhāraṇaṃ //
151.d:
रङ्गावतरणं प्रोक्तं तथा शिल्पैश् च जीवनं /
वहिर्ग्रामनिवासश् च मृतचेलस्य धारणं //
151.m: entering the stage is prescribed, as well as living by crafts. / Dwelling outside the village, wearing the clothes of the dead,

151.s:
na saṃsparśastathaivānyaiś caṇḍālasya vidhīyate /
brāhmaṇārthe gavārthe vā dehatyāgo 'tra yaḥ kṛtaḥ //
151.d:
न संस्पर्शस्तथैवान्यैश् चण्डालस्य विधीयते /
ब्राह्मणार्थे गवार्थे वा देहत्यागो ऽत्र यः कृतः //
151.m: and no physical contact with others is prescribed for a caṇḍāla. / Whoever here gives up their body for the sake of a brāhmaṇa or a cow,

151.s:
strībālādyupapato vā vāhyāṇāṃ siddhikāraṇaṃ /
saṅkare jātayo jñeyāḥ piturmātuś ca karmataḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe varṇāntaradharmā
nāmaikapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha dvipañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
gṛhasthavṛttiḥ
151.d:
स्त्रीबालाद्युपपतो वा वाह्याणां सिद्धिकारणं /
सङ्करे जातयो ज्ञेयाः पितुर्मातुश् च कर्मतः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे वर्णान्तरधर्मा
नामैकपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ द्विपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
गृहस्थवृत्तिः
151.m:
or in defense of women, children, and others, is the cause of spiritual success for outcastes. / Castes arising in miscegenation should be known through the acts of father and mother.
Thus ends the one hundred fifty-first chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, entitled “Duties of the Intermediate Castes.”
Now, the one hundred fifty-second chapter:
The Livelihood of the Householder.

152.s:
puṣkara uvāca
ājīvaṃstu yathoktena brāhmaṇaḥ svena karmaṇā /
kṣatraviṭśūdradharmeṇa jīvennaiva tu śūdrajāt //
152.d:
पुष्कर उवाच
आजीवंस्तु यथोक्तेन ब्राह्मणः स्वेन कर्मणा /
क्षत्रविट्शूद्रधर्मेण जीवेन्नैव तु शूद्रजात् //
152.m: Puṣkara said: / A brāhmaṇa unable to make a living by his own prescribed duty / may live by the duty of a kṣatriya, vaiśya, or śūdra, but never from a śūdra's birth.

152.s:
kṛṣibāṇijyagorakṣyaṃ kuśīdañca dvijaś caret /
gorasaṃ guḍalavaṇalākṣāmāṃsāni varjayet //
:n
1 śrījīvanañca tatra syāt proktamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca
:p 119
152.d:
कृषिबाणिज्यगोरक्ष्यं कुशीदञ्च द्विजश् चरेत् /
गोरसं गुडलवणलाक्षामांसानि वर्जयेत् //
:न्
1 श्रीजीवनञ्च तत्र स्यात् प्रोक्तमिति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 119
152.m:
A twice-born may engage in agriculture, trade, cattle-rearing, and usury; / he must avoid milk products, molasses, salt, lac, and meat.
[Footnote]
1. "And prosperous living may be there" is stated in ga, gha, ṅa, and ña.

152.s:
bhūmiṃ bhitvauṣadhīśchitvā hutvā koṭapipīlikān /
punanti khalu yajñena karṣakā devapūjanāt //
152.d:
भूमिं भित्वौषधीश्छित्वा हुत्वा कोटपिपीलिकान् /
पुनन्ति खलु यज्ञेन कर्षका देवपूजनात् //
152.m: Having tilled the earth, cut down plants, and immolated worms and ants, / farmers indeed purify themselves through sacrifice by worshipping the gods.

152.s:
halamaṣṭagavaṃ dharmyaṃ ṣaḍgavaṃ jīvitārthināṃ /
carturgavaṃ nṛśaṃsānāṃ dvigavaṃ dharmaghātināṃ //
152.d:
हलमष्टगवं धर्म्यं षड्गवं जीवितार्थिनां /
चर्तुर्गवं नृशंसानां द्विगवं धर्मघातिनां //
152.m: A plow with eight oxen is righteous; with six oxen, for those seeking a livelihood; / with four oxen, for the cruel; with two oxen, for the slayers of dharma.

152.s:
ṛtāmṛtābhyāṃ jīveta mṛtena pramṛtena vā /
satyānṛtābhyāmapivā na svavṛttyā kadā ca na //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe gṛhasthavṛttayo nāma
vripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
brahmacaryāśramadharmaḥ
152.d:
ऋतामृताभ्यां जीवेत मृतेन प्रमृतेन वा /
सत्यानृताभ्यामपिवा न स्ववृत्त्या कदा च न //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे गृहस्थवृत्तयो नाम
व्रिपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ त्रिपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमधर्मः
152.m:
He may live by the gleaning or the ungleaned, by what is dead or what is cultivated, / or even by truth and falsehood, but never by dog-like service.
Thus ends the one hundred fifty-second chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, entitled “Livelihoods of the Householder.”
Now, the one hundred fifty-third chapter:
Duties of the Stage of Celibate Studenthood.

153.s:
puṣkara uvāca
dharmamāśramiṇāṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu /
ṣoḍaśartuniśā strīṇāmādyastisrastu garhitāḥ //
153.d:
पुष्कर उवाच
धर्ममाश्रमिणां वक्ष्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं शृणु /
षोडशर्तुनिशा स्त्रीणामाद्यस्तिस्रस्तु गर्हिताः //
153.m: Puṣkara said: / I shall state the duty of those in the life stages, which bestows worldly enjoyment and liberation; listen. / The fertile period of women consists of sixteen nights; the first three are censured.

153.s:
vrajedyugmāsu putrārthī karmādhānikamiṣyate /
garbhasya spaṣṭatājñāne savanaṃ spandanāt purā //
153.d:
व्रजेद्युग्मासु पुत्रार्थी कर्माधानिकमिष्यते /
गर्भस्य स्पष्टताज्ञाने सवनं स्पन्दनात् पुरा //
153.m: Desiring a son, he should approach her on even nights; this is desired as the rite of conception. / When the embryo is clearly discerned, the rite to produce a male child [is performed] before it quickens.

153.s:
ṣaṣṭhe 'ṣṭame vā sīmantaṃ putrīyaṃ nāmabhaṃ śubhaṃ /
acchinnanāḍyāṃ kartavyaṃ jātakarma vicakṣaṇaiḥ //
153.d:
षष्ठे ऽष्टमे वा सीमन्तं पुत्रीयं नामभं शुभं /
अच्छिन्ननाड्यां कर्तव्यं जातकर्म विचक्षणैः //
153.m: In the sixth or eighth month, the parting of the hair [is performed]; an auspicious asterism suited for a son [is chosen]. / Before the umbilical cord is severed, the birth-rite must be performed by the wise.

153.s:
aśauce tu vyatikrānte nāmakarma vidhīyate /
śarmāntaṃ brāhmasyoktaṃ varmāntaṃ kṣatriyasya tu //
153.d:
अशौचे तु व्यतिक्रान्ते नामकर्म विधीयते /
शर्मान्तं ब्राह्मस्योक्तं वर्मान्तं क्षत्रियस्य तु //
153.m: When ritual impurity has passed, the naming rite is prescribed: / ending in -śarman is stated for a brāhmaṇa, and ending in -varman for a kṣatriya.

153.s:
guptadāsātmakaṃ nāma praśastaṃ vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ /
:p 120
śarmāntaṃ brahmaṇasyoktaṃ varmāntaṃ kṣatriyasya ca //
153.d:
गुप्तदासात्मकं नाम प्रशस्तं वैश्यशूद्रयोः /
:प् 120
शर्मान्तं ब्रह्मणस्योक्तं वर्मान्तं क्षत्रियस्य च //
153.m:
A name consisting of -gupta and -dāsa is commended for a vaiśya and a śūdra.
[Page] 120
Ending in -śarman is stated for a brāhmaṇa, and ending in -varman for a kṣatriya.

153.s:
guptadāsātmakaṃ nāma praśastaṃ vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ /
bālaṃ nivedayedbhartre tava putro 'yamityuta //
153.d:
गुप्तदासात्मकं नाम प्रशस्तं वैश्यशूद्रयोः /
बालं निवेदयेद्भर्त्रे तव पुत्रो ऽयमित्युत //
153.m: A name consisting of -gupta and -dāsa is commended for a vaiśya and a śūdra. / One should present the child to the husband, saying: “This is your son.”

153.s:
yathākulantu cūḍākṛd brāhmaṇasyopanāyanaṃ /
garbhāṣṭame 'ṣṭame vābde garbhādekādaśe nṛpe //
153.d:
यथाकुलन्तु चूडाकृद् ब्राह्मणस्योपनायनं /
गर्भाष्टमे ऽष्टमे वाब्दे गर्भादेकादशे नृपे //
153.m: Tonsure is performed according to family custom. The initiation of a brāhmaṇa / is in the eighth year from conception or the eighth year [from birth]; for a king, in the eleventh from conception;

153.s:
garbhāttu dvādaśe vaiśye ṣoḍaśābdādito na hi /
muñjānāṃ valkalānāntu kramānmaujjyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
153.d:
गर्भात्तु द्वादशे वैश्ये षोडशाब्दादितो न हि /
मुञ्जानां वल्कलानान्तु क्रमान्मौज्ज्याः प्रकीर्तिताः //
153.m: in the twelfth from conception for a vaiśya; never beyond the sixteenth year. / The girdles are declared to be made of muñja grass, bark fibers, [and wool] respectively.

153.s:
mārgavaiyādhravāstāni carmāṇi vratacāriṇāṃ /
parṇapippalavilvānāṃ kramāddaṇḍāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
153.d:
मार्गवैयाध्रवास्तानि चर्माणि व्रतचारिणां /
पर्णपिप्पलविल्वानां क्रमाद्दण्डाः प्रकीर्तिताः //
153.m: Antelope, tiger, and goat skins are for those observing the vows. / The staffs are declared to be of parṇa, pippala, and bilva respectively,

153.s:
keśadeśalalāṭāsyatulyāḥ proktāḥ krameṇa tu /
avakrāḥ satvacaḥ sarve nāvipluṣṭāstu daṇḍakāḥ //
153.d:
केशदेशललाटास्यतुल्याः प्रोक्ताः क्रमेण तु /
अवक्राः सत्वचः सर्वे नाविप्लुष्टास्तु दण्डकाः //
153.m: reaching up to the hair line, forehead, and mouth respectively, / all unbent, with bark, and unburnt.
The upper garment and sacred thread are made of cotton, flax, and wool respectively. / Characterized by the word bhavat at the beginning, middle, and end,

153.s:
prathamaṃ tatra bhhikṣeta yatra bhikṣā dhruvaṃ bhavet /
strīṇāmamantratastāni vivāhastu samantrakaḥ //
153.d:
प्रथमं तत्र भ्हिक्षेत यत्र भिक्षा ध्रुवं भवेत् /
स्त्रीणाममन्त्रतस्तानि विवाहस्तु समन्त्रकः //
153.m: he should beg first where alms are certain. / For women, those [rites] are without mantras; marriage, however, is with mantras.

153.s:
upanīya guruḥ śiṣyaṃ sikṣayecchaucamāditaḥ /
ācāramagnikāryaṃ ca sandhyopāsanameva ca //
153.d:
उपनीय गुरुः शिष्यं सिक्षयेच्छौचमादितः /
आचारमग्निकार्यं च सन्ध्योपासनमेव च //
153.m: Having initiated the disciple, the guru should instruct him first in ritual purity, / right conduct, the fire ritual, and the twilight worship.

153.s:
āyuṣyaṃ prāṅmukho bhuṅkte yaśasyaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ /
śriyaṃ pratyaṅmukhī bhuṅkte ṛtaṃ bhuṅkte udaṅmukhaḥ //
153.d:
आयुष्यं प्राङ्मुखो भुङ्क्ते यशस्यं दक्षिणामुखः /
श्रियं प्रत्यङ्मुखी भुङ्क्ते ऋतं भुङ्क्ते उदङ्मुखः //
153.m: Facing east he eats longevity; facing south he eats fame; / facing west he eats prosperity; facing north he eats truth.

153.s:
sāyaṃ prātaś ca juhuyān nāmedhyaṃ vyastahastakaṃ /
madhu māṃsa janaiḥ sārdhaṃ gītaṃ nṛtyañca vai tyajet(1) //
:n
1 nṛtyañca varjayediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca / sāyaṃ
prātaścetyādiḥ, nṛtyañca vai tyajedityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake
nāsti
:p 121
153.d:
सायं प्रातश् च जुहुयान् नामेध्यं व्यस्तहस्तकं /
मधु मांस जनैः सार्धं गीतं नृत्यञ्च वै त्यजेत्(1) //
:न्
1 नृत्यञ्च वर्जयेदिति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च / सायं
प्रातश्चेत्यादिः, नृत्यञ्च वै त्यजेदित्यन्तः पाठः ज.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
:प् 121
153.m:
He should offer oblations evening and morning, not touch anything impure with crossed hands, / and he should abandon honey, meat, singing, and dancing with other people.
[Footnote]
1. "And he should avoid dancing" is the variant in kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cha, ña, and ṭa. The reading beginning with "evening and morning" and ending with "and he should abandon dancing" is missing in manuscript ja.

153.s:
hiṃsāmparāpavādaṃ ca aślīlaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ /
daṇḍādi dhārayennaṣṭamapsu kṣiptvānyadhāraṇaṃ //
153.d:
हिंसाम्परापवादं च अश्लीलं च विशेषतः /
दण्डादि धारयेन्नष्टमप्सु क्षिप्त्वान्यधारणं //
153.m: Violence, blaming others, and especially vulgar speech [must be avoided]. / When the staff and other articles are damaged, he should throw them into the water and take others.
Having mastered the Veda and having given the sacrificial fee, he should bathe [as an initiate];

153.s:
17cd /. naiṣṭhiko brahmacārī vā dehāntaṃ nivasedgurau //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe brahmacaryāśramo nāma
tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha catuḥpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
vivāhaḥ
153.d:
17च्द् /. नैष्ठिको ब्रह्मचारी वा देहान्तं निवसेद्गुरौ //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमो नाम
त्रिपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ चतुःपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
विवाहः
153.m:
or, as a lifelong celibate student, he should reside with the guru until the end of his body.
Thus ends the one hundred fifty-third chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, entitled “The Stage of Celibate Studenthood.”
Now, the one hundred fifty-fourth chapter:
Marriage.

154.s:
puṣkara uvāca
vipraś catasro vindeta bhāryāstisrastu bhūmipaḥ /
dve ca vaiśyo yathākāmaṃ bhāryaikāmapi cāntyajaḥ //
154.d:
पुष्कर उवाच
विप्रश् चतस्रो विन्देत भार्यास्तिस्रस्तु भूमिपः /
द्वे च वैश्यो यथाकामं भार्यैकामपि चान्त्यजः //
154.m: Puṣkara said: / A brāhmaṇa may take four wives; a king, three; / a vaiśya, two, according to desire; and the lowest born, one wife.

154.s:
dharmakāryāṇi sarvāṇi na kāryāṇyasavarṇayā /
pāṇirgrāhyaḥ savarṇāsu gṛhṇīyāt ksatriyā śaraṃ //
154.d:
धर्मकार्याणि सर्वाणि न कार्याण्यसवर्णया /
पाणिर्ग्राह्यः सवर्णासु गृह्णीयात् क्सत्रिया शरं //
154.m: All acts of dharma are not to be performed with a wife of another caste. / The hand is to be taken among women of the same caste; a kṣatriya woman should hold an arrow;

154.s:
vaiśyā pratīdamādadyāddaśāṃ vai cāntyajā tathā /
sakṛt kanyā pradātavyā haraṃstāṃ cauradaṇḍabhāk //
154.d:
वैश्या प्रतीदमादद्याद्दशां वै चान्त्यजा तथा /
सकृत् कन्या प्रदातव्या हरंस्तां चौरदण्डभाक् //
154.m: a vaiśyā should take a goad, and the lowest-born woman the skirt of a garment. / A maiden is to be given away only once; one who abducts her incurs the punishment of a thief.

154.s:
apatyavikrayāsakte niṣkṛtir na vidhīyate /
kanyādānaṃ śacīyogo(1) vivāho 'tha caturthikā //
:n
1 satīyoga iti kha.. , cha.. ca
:p 122
154.d:
अपत्यविक्रयासक्ते निष्कृतिर् न विधीयते /
कन्यादानं शचीयोगो(1) विवाहो ऽथ चतुर्थिका //
:न्
1 सतीयोग इति ख.. , छ.. च
:प् 122
154.m:
For one intent on the sale of offspring, no expiation is prescribed. / The giving of a maiden, the union with Indrāṇī, the wedding, and the rite of the fourth day:
[Footnote]
1. "The union with a virtuous woman" is the variant in kha and cha.

154.s:
vivāhametat kathitaṃ nāmakarmacatuṣṭayaṃ /
naṣṭe mṛte pravrajite klīve ca patite patau //
154.d:
विवाहमेतत् कथितं नामकर्मचतुष्टयं /
नष्टे मृते प्रव्रजिते क्लीवे च पतिते पतौ //
154.m: this fourfold named rite is declared to constitute marriage. / If the husband is disappeared, dead, renounced, impotent, or degraded,

154.s:
pañcasvāpatsu nārīṇāṃ patiranyo vidhīyate /
mṛte tu devare deyāt tadabhāve yathecchayā //
154.d:
पञ्चस्वापत्सु नारीणां पतिरन्यो विधीयते /
मृते तु देवरे देयात् तदभावे यथेच्छया //
154.m: in these five misfortunes another husband is prescribed for women. / Upon his death, she should be given to a brother-in-law; in his absence, as she pleases.

154.s:
pūrvātritayamāgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ cottarātrayaṃ /
rohiṇau ceti caraṇe bhagaṇaḥ śasyate sadā //
154.d:
पूर्वात्रितयमाग्नेयं वायव्यं चोत्तरात्रयं /
रोहिणौ चेति चरणे भगणः शस्यते सदा //
154.m: The triad of Pūrvā asterisms, the Āgneya, the Vāyavya, the triad of Uttarā asterisms, / and the two Rohiṇīs—these asterisms are always commended in the foot.

154.s:
naikagotrāntu varayennaikārṣeyāñca bhārgava /
pitṛtaḥ saptamādūrdhvaṃ mātṛtaḥ pañcamāttathā //
154.d:
नैकगोत्रान्तु वरयेन्नैकार्षेयाञ्च भार्गव /
पितृतः सप्तमादूर्ध्वं मातृतः पञ्चमात्तथा //
154.m: One should not choose a maiden of the same gotra or same ancestral lineage, O descendant of Bhṛgu; / [she should be] beyond the seventh degree on the father's side and beyond the fifth from the mother's side.

154.s:
āhūya dānaṃ brāhmaḥ syāt kulaśīlayutāya tu /
puruṣāṃstārayettajjo nityaṃ kanyapradānataḥ //
154.d:
आहूय दानं ब्राह्मः स्यात् कुलशीलयुताय तु /
पुरुषांस्तारयेत्तज्जो नित्यं कन्यप्रदानतः //
154.m: The gift [of a maiden] after having invited a man endowed with good lineage and conduct is the Brāhma rite; / one born of that [union] always liberates his ancestors through the gift of the maiden.

154.s:
tathā gomithunādānādvivāhastvārṣa ucyate /
prārthitā dīyate yasya prājāpatyaḥ sa dharmakṛt //
154.d:
तथा गोमिथुनादानाद्विवाहस्त्वार्ष उच्यते /
प्रार्थिता दीयते यस्य प्राजापत्यः स धर्मकृत् //
154.m: So too, by the receipt of a pair of cattle, a marriage is said to be Ārṣa. / The Prājāpatya rite, which produces merit, is that where she is given when requested.

154.s:
śulkena cāsuro mando gāndharvo varaṇānmithaḥ /
rākṣaso yuddhaharaṇāt paiśācaḥ kanyakācchalāt //
154.d:
शुल्केन चासुरो मन्दो गान्धर्वो वरणान्मिथः /
राक्षसो युद्धहरणात् पैशाचः कन्यकाच्छलात् //
154.m: The Asura is inferior, by means of a bride-price; the Gāndharva is by mutual choice; / the Rākṣasa is by taking by battle; the Paiśāca is through deceit of the maiden.

154.s:
vaivāhike 'hni(1) kurvīta kumbhakāramṛdā śucīṃ /
jalāśaye tu tāṃ pūjya vādyādyaiḥ(2) strīṃ gṛhatrayet //
154.d:
वैवाहिके ऽह्नि(1) कुर्वीत कुम्भकारमृदा शुचीं /
जलाशये तु तां पूज्य वाद्याद्यैः(2) स्त्रीं गृहत्रयेत् //
154.m: On the day of marriage, one should purify [the earth] using clay from a potter; / having worshipped it at a reservoir of water with musical instruments and the like, [the women] should take the woman to the house.

154.s:
praśupte keśave naiva vivāhaḥ kārya eva hi /
poṣe caitre kujadine riktāviṣṭitatho na ca //
154.d:
प्रशुप्ते केशवे नैव विवाहः कार्य एव हि /
पोषे चैत्रे कुजदिने रिक्ताविष्टितथो न च //
154.m: Marriage should not be performed when Keśava is asleep, / nor in Pauṣa, Caitra, on Tuesday, or on an empty lunar day (riktā) or viṣṭi (karaṇa).

154.s:
na śukrajīve 'stamite na śaśāṅke grahārdite /
arkārkabhaumayukte bhe vyatīpātahate na hi //
154.d:
न शुक्रजीवे ऽस्तमिते न शशाङ्के ग्रहार्दिते /
अर्कार्कभौमयुक्ते भे व्यतीपातहते न हि //
154.m: Nor when Venus or Jupiter has set; nor when the moon is afflicted by a planet; / not under a constellation joined with the Sun, Saturn, or Mars, nor when struck by Vyatīpāta.

154.s:
somyaṃ pitryañca vāyavyaṃ sāvitraṃ rohiṇī tathā /
:n
1 vaivāhikebde iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
2 vādyaughair iti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
:p 123
uttarātritayaṃ mūlaṃ maitraṃ pauṣṇaṃ vivāhabhaṃ //
154.d:
सोम्यं पित्र्यञ्च वायव्यं सावित्रं रोहिणी तथा /
:न्
1 वैवाहिकेब्दे इति घ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
2 वाद्यौघैर् इति ग.. , घ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 123
उत्तरात्रितयं मूलं मैत्रं पौष्णं विवाहभं //
154.m:
Mṛgaśīrṣā (saumya), Maghā (pitrya), Svātī (vāyavya), Hasta (sāvitra), and Rohiṇī,
:n
1 'vaivāhikebde' in gha, ṅa, ña, and ṭa.
2 'vādyaughaiḥ' in ga, gha, and ña.
:p 123
the triad of Uttarās (Uttaraphālgunī, Uttarāṣāḍhā, Uttarabhādrapadā), Mūla, Anurādhā (maitra), and Revatī (pauṣṇa)—these are the marriage asterisms.

154.s:
mānuṣākhyas tathā lagno mānuṣākhyāṃśakaḥ śubhaḥ /
tṛtīye ca tathā ṣaṣṭhe daśamaikādaśe 'ṣṭame //
154.d:
मानुषाख्यस् तथा लग्नो मानुषाख्यांशकः शुभः /
तृतीये च तथा षष्ठे दशमैकादशे ऽष्टमे //
154.m: An ascendant called human (mānuṣa) and a navāṃśa called human are auspicious. / In the third, sixth, tenth, eleventh, and eighth [houses],

154.s:
arkārkicandatanayāḥ praśastā na kujo 'ṣṭamaḥ /
saptāntyāṣṭamavargeṣu śeṣāḥ śastā grahottamāḥ //
154.d:
अर्कार्किचन्दतनयाः प्रशस्ता न कुजो ऽष्टमः /
सप्तान्त्याष्टमवर्गेषु शेषाः शस्ता ग्रहोत्तमाः //
154.m: the Sun, Saturn, and Mercury (candratanaya) are praised; Mars in the eighth is not [praised]. / In the seventh, twelfth, and eighth divisions, the remaining excellent planets are praised.

154.s:
teṣāmapi tathā madhyāt ṣaṣṭhaḥ śukro na śasyate /
vaivāhike bhe kartavyā tathaiva ca caturthikā //
154.d:
तेषामपि तथा मध्यात् षष्ठः शुक्रो न शस्यते /
वैवाहिके भे कर्तव्या तथैव च चतुर्थिका //
154.m: Among them, Venus in the sixth is not commended. / The fourth-day rite (caturthikā) likewise should be performed under the marriage asterism.

154.s:
na dātavyā grahāstatra caturādyāstathaikagāḥ /
parvavarjaṃ striyaṃ gacchet satyā dattā sadā ratiḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe vivāho nāma
satuḥpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
ācāraḥ
154.d:
न दातव्या ग्रहास्तत्र चतुराद्यास्तथैकगाः /
पर्ववर्जं स्त्रियं गच्छेत् सत्या दत्ता सदा रतिः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे विवाहो नाम
सतुःपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ पञ्चपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
आचारः
154.m:
Planets in the fourth and other houses, or occupying one [house], should not be given. / Avoiding the parvan days, one should approach his wife; sexual enjoyment given to a truthful wife is constant.
Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-fourth chapter, named 'Marriage,' in the Great Purāṇa of Agni.
Now begins the one hundred and fifty-fifth chapter.
Right Conduct.

155.s:
puṣkara uvāca
brāhme muhūrte cotthāya viṣṇvādīn daivatān smaret /
ubhe mūtrapurīṣe tu divā kuryādudaṅmukhaḥ //
155.d:
पुष्कर उवाच
ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते चोत्थाय विष्ण्वादीन् दैवतान् स्मरेत् /
उभे मूत्रपुरीषे तु दिवा कुर्यादुदङ्मुखः //
155.m: Puṣkara said: / Rising at the hour of Brahmā (brāhmamuhūrta), one should remember the deities headed by Viṣṇu. / Facing north, one should pass both urine and feces by day;

155.s:
rātau ca dakṣiṇe kuryādubhe sandhye yathā divā /
na mārgādau jale vīpyāṃ satṛṇāyāṃ sadācaret //
:p 124
155.d:
रातौ च दक्षिणे कुर्यादुभे सन्ध्ये यथा दिवा /
न मार्गादौ जले वीप्यां सतृणायां सदाचरेत् //
:प् 124
155.m:
and by night, one should do so facing south; at both twilights, as by day. / One must never do so on a road, in water, in a well, or on grass.
:p 124

155.s:
śaucaṃ kṛtvā mṛdācamya bhakṣayeddantadhāvanaṃ /
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ kriyāṅgaṃ malakarṣaṇaṃ //
155.d:
शौचं कृत्वा मृदाचम्य भक्षयेद्दन्तधावनं /
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं काम्यं क्रियाङ्गं मलकर्षणं //
155.m: Having performed purification with earth and sipped water (ācamana), one should use a tooth-stick. / Daily, occasional, motivated, ancillary to rites, and removal of impurities—

155.s:
kriyāsnānaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhaṃ ṣoḍhāsnānaṃ prakīrtitaṃ /
asnātasyāphalaṃ karma prātaḥsnānaṃ carettataḥ //
155.d:
क्रियास्नानं तथा षष्ठं षोढास्नानं प्रकीर्तितं /
अस्नातस्याफलं कर्म प्रातःस्नानं चरेत्ततः //
155.m: together with bathing for ritual actions as the sixth—bathing is declared to be sixfold. / The work of one who has not bathed bears no fruit; therefore, one should perform the morning bath.

155.s:
bhūmiṣṭhamuddhṛtāt puṇyaṃ tataḥ prasravaṇodakaṃ /
tato 'pi sārasaṃ puṇyaṃ tasmānnādeyamucyate //
155.d:
भूमिष्ठमुद्धृतात् पुण्यं ततः प्रस्रवणोदकं /
ततो ऽपि सारसं पुण्यं तस्मान्नादेयमुच्यते //
155.m: Water found on the ground is more meritorious than drawn water; spring water is more meritorious than that; / lake water is more meritorious than that; river water is declared to be even more meritorious than that;

155.s:
tīrthatoyaṃ tataḥ puṇyaṃ gāṅgaṃ puṇyantu sarvataḥ /
saṃśodhitamalaḥ pūrvaṃ nimagnaś ca jalāśaye //
155.d:
तीर्थतोयं ततः पुण्यं गाङ्गं पुण्यन्तु सर्वतः /
संशोधितमलः पूर्वं निमग्नश् च जलाशये //
155.m: water from a sacred ford (tīrtha) is more meritorious than that, but water from the Gaṅgā is meritorious above all. / Having first washed away impurities and submerged himself in a body of water,

155.s:
upaspṛśya tataḥ kuryādambhasaḥ parimārjanaṃ /
hiraṇyavarṇāstisṛbhiḥ śanno devīti cāpyatha //
155.d:
उपस्पृश्य ततः कुर्यादम्भसः परिमार्जनं /
हिरण्यवर्णास्तिसृभिः शन्नो देवीति चाप्यथ //
155.m: and having touched water (upaspṛśya), one should then sprinkle oneself with water, / reciting the three verses beginning with 'hiraṇyavarṇāḥ' and also 'śanno devīḥ',

155.s:
āpohiṣṭheti tisṛbhiridamāpastathaiva ca /
tato jalāśaye magnaḥ kuryādantarjalaṃ japaṃ //
155.d:
आपोहिष्ठेति तिसृभिरिदमापस्तथैव च /
ततो जलाशये मग्नः कुर्यादन्तर्जलं जपं //
155.m: with the three verses beginning with 'āpo hi ṣṭhā', and likewise 'idam āpaḥ'. / Then, submerged in the reservoir of water, one should perform recitation under water.

155.s:
tatrāghamarṣaṇaṃ sūktaṃ drupadāṃ vā tathā japet /
yuñjate mana ity evaṃ sūktaṃ sūktaṃ vāpyatha pauruṣaṃ //
155.d:
तत्राघमर्षणं सूक्तं द्रुपदां वा तथा जपेत् /
युञ्जते मन इत्य् एवं सूक्तं सूक्तं वाप्यथ पौरुषं //
155.m: There one should recite the Aghamarṣaṇa hymn, or the Drupadā hymn, / or the hymn 'yuñjate manaḥ', or the Puruṣa hymn (pauruṣasūkta).

155.s:
gāyatrīṃ tu viśeṣeṇa aghamarṣaṇasūktake /
devatā bhāvavṛttastu ṛṣiś caivāghamarṣaṇaḥ //
155.d:
गायत्रीं तु विशेषेण अघमर्षणसूक्तके /
देवता भाववृत्तस्तु ऋषिश् चैवाघमर्षणः //
155.m: Especially the Gāyatrī. In the Aghamarṣaṇa hymn, / the deity is Bhāvavṛtta, and the sage is Aghamarṣaṇa;

155.s:
chandaścānuṣṭubhaṃ tasya bhāvavṛtto hariḥ smṛtaḥ /
āpīḍamānaḥ śāṭīṃ tu devatāpitṛtarpaṇaṃ(1) //
155.d:
छन्दश्चानुष्टुभं तस्य भाववृत्तो हरिः स्मृतः /
आपीडमानः शाटीं तु देवतापितृतर्पणं(1) //
155.m: its metre is anuṣṭubh, and Hari is remembered as Bhāvavṛtta. / Wringing out his garment, he should offer libations (tarpaṇa) to the deities and ancestors.

155.s:
pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena dadeccaivodakāñjaliṃ /
tato 'gnihavanaṃ(2) kuryāddānaṃ datvā(3) tu śaktitaḥ //
:n
1 tatrāghamarṣaṇamityādiḥ devatāpitṛtarpaṇamityantaḥ
pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti
2 tato 'gniharaṇamiti ṅa.. , cha.. ca
3 dīpaṃ datveti jha..
:p 125
155.d:
पौरुषेण तु सूक्तेन ददेच्चैवोदकाञ्जलिं /
ततो ऽग्निहवनं(2) कुर्याद्दानं दत्वा(3) तु शक्तितः //
:न्
1 तत्राघमर्षणमित्यादिः देवतापितृतर्पणमित्यन्तः
पाठः झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
2 ततो ऽग्निहरणमिति ङ.. , छ.. च
3 दीपं दत्वेति झ..
:प् 125
155.m:
With the Puruṣa hymn, he should offer a handful of water. / Then he should perform the fire-oblation (agnihavana), having given a gift according to his ability.
:n
1 The passage from 'tatrāghamarṣaṇam' to 'devatāpitṛtarpaṇam' is not in manuscript jha.
2 'tato 'gniharaṇam' in ṅa and cha.
3 'dīpaṃ datvā' in jha.
:p 125

155.s:
tataḥ samabhigaccheta yogākṣemārthamīśvaraṃ /
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ jāyāpatyaṅkamaṇḍaluḥ //
155.d:
ततः समभिगच्छेत योगाक्षेमार्थमीश्वरं /
आसनं शयनं यानं जायापत्यङ्कमण्डलुः //
155.m: Then he should approach the lord for the sake of prosperity and security (yogakṣema). / One's seat, bed, vehicle, wife, child, and water-pot—

155.s:
ātmanaḥ śuciretāni pareṣāṃ na śucirbhavet /
bhārākrāntasya gurviṇyāḥ panthā deyo guruṣvapi //
155.d:
आत्मनः शुचिरेतानि परेषां न शुचिर्भवेत् /
भाराक्रान्तस्य गुर्विण्याः पन्था देयो गुरुष्वपि //
155.m: these are pure for oneself; they are not pure for others. / Way should be given to one laden with a burden, to a pregnant woman, and to elders.

155.s:
na paśyeccārkamudyantannāstaṃ yāntaṃ na cāmbhasi /
nekṣennagnāṃ striyaṃ kūpaṃ śūnāsthānamaghaughinaṃ //
155.d:
न पश्येच्चार्कमुद्यन्तन्नास्तं यान्तं न चाम्भसि /
नेक्षेन्नग्नां स्त्रियं कूपं शूनास्थानमघौघिनं //
155.m: One should not look at the rising sun, nor at it setting, nor in water; / one should not look at a naked woman, into a well, at a slaughterhouse, or at a heap of sins.

155.s:
kārpāsāthi tayā bhasma nākrāmed yacca kutsitaṃ /
antaḥpuraṃ vittigṛhaṃ paradautyaṃ brajenna hi(1) //
155.d:
कार्पासाथि तया भस्म नाक्रामेद् यच्च कुत्सितं /
अन्तःपुरं वित्तिगृहं परदौत्यं ब्रजेन्न हि(1) //
155.m: One should not step on cotton seeds, bones, or ashes, or anything contemptible; / nor enter the royal women's quarters, the house of finance, or undertake another's embassy.

155.s:
nārohedviṣamānnāvanna vṛkṣaṃ na ca parvataṃ /
arthāyatanaśāstreṣu tathaiva syāt kutūhalī //
155.d:
नारोहेद्विषमान्नावन्न वृक्षं न च पर्वतं /
अर्थायतनशास्त्रेषु तथैव स्यात् कुतूहली //
155.m: One should not board a precarious boat, nor climb a tree or a mountain; / one should likewise be curious about treatises dealing with the acquisition of wealth.

155.s:
loṣṭamardo tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī vinaśyati /
mukhādivādanaṃ nehed vinā dīpaṃ na rātrigaḥ(2) //
155.d:
लोष्टमर्दो तृणच्छेदी नखखादी विनश्यति /
मुखादिवादनं नेहेद् विना दीपं न रात्रिगः(2) //
155.m: One who crushes clods of earth, tears grass, or bites nails perishes. / One should not make sounds with one's mouth or the like; one should not walk at night without a lamp.

155.s:
nādvāreṇa viśedveśma na ca vaktraṃ virāgayet /
kathābhaṅgaṃ na kurvīta na ca vāsoviparyayaṃ //
155.d:
नाद्वारेण विशेद्वेश्म न च वक्त्रं विरागयेत् /
कथाभङ्गं न कुर्वीत न च वासोविपर्ययं //
155.m: One should not enter a house except by the door, nor make a distorted face; / one should not interrupt a conversation, nor wear clothes inside out.

155.s:
bhadraṃ bhadramiti brūyānnāniṣṭaṃ kīrtayet kvacit /
pālāśamāsanaṃ varjyaṃ devādicchāyayā(3) vrajet //
155.d:
भद्रं भद्रमिति ब्रूयान्नानिष्टं कीर्तयेत् क्वचित् /
पालाशमासनं वर्ज्यं देवादिच्छायया(3) व्रजेत् //
155.m: One should say 'auspicious, auspicious', and never mention what is disagreeable. / A seat of palāśa wood is to be avoided; one should walk through the shadow of deities and the like.

155.s:
na madhye pūjyayoryāyāt nocchiṣṭastārakādidṛk /
nadyānnānyāṃ nadīṃ brūyānna kaṇḍūyed dvihastakaṃ //
155.d:
न मध्ये पूज्ययोर्यायात् नोच्छिष्टस्तारकादिदृक् /
नद्यान्नान्यां नदीं ब्रूयान्न कण्डूयेद् द्विहस्तकं //
155.m: One should not walk between two venerable persons, nor look at the stars or the like while impure with food remnants; / one should not speak of one river while at another, nor scratch with both hands.

155.s:
asantarpya pitṝn devānnadīpārañca na vrajet /
malādiprakṣipennāpsu(4) na nagnaḥ snānamācaret //
:n
1 parabhṛto bhavenna hi iti jha..
2 loṣṭamaddītyādiḥ, na rātriga ity antaḥ pāṭhaḥ, ga.pustake
nāsti
3 devādricchāyayeti kha.. , cha.. , ga.. ca
4 malādikṣepayennāpsu iti kha.. , ṭa.. ca
:p 126
155.d:
असन्तर्प्य पितॄन् देवान्नदीपारञ्च न व्रजेत् /
मलादिप्रक्षिपेन्नाप्सु(4) न नग्नः स्नानमाचरेत् //
:न्
1 परभृतो भवेन्न हि इति झ..
2 लोष्टमद्दीत्यादिः, न रात्रिग इत्य् अन्तः पाठः, ग.पुस्तके
नास्ति
3 देवाद्रिच्छाययेति ख.. , छ.. , ग.. च
4 मलादिक्षेपयेन्नाप्सु इति ख.. , ट.. च
:प् 126
155.m:
Without satisfying the ancestors and the deities, one should not cross to the other side of a river. / One should not throw excrement or the like into water, nor bathe naked.
:n
1 'parabhṛto bhaven na hi' in jha.
2 The passage from 'loṣṭamaddī' to 'na rātrigaḥ' is missing in manuscript ga.
3 'devādricchāyayā' in kha, cha, and ga.
4 'malādikṣepayennāpsu' in kha and ṭa.
:p 126

155.s:
tataḥ samabhigaccheta yogakṣemārthamīśvaraṃ /
srajannātmanāppanayet kharādikarajastyajet //
155.d:
ततः समभिगच्छेत योगक्षेमार्थमीश्वरं /
स्रजन्नात्मनाप्पनयेत् खरादिकरजस्त्यजेत् //
155.m: Then he should approach the lord for the sake of prosperity and security. / One should not remove a garland oneself; one should discard dust from donkeys and the like.

155.s:
hīnānnāvahaset gacchennādeśe niyasecca taiḥ /
vaidyarājanadīhīne mlecchastrībahunāyake //
155.d:
हीनान्नावहसेत् गच्छेन्नादेशे नियसेच्च तैः /
वैद्यराजनदीहीने म्लेच्छस्त्रीबहुनायके //
155.m: One should not mock inferior persons, nor reside with them in an improper place, / or in a place lacking physicians, a king, or a river, or where barbarians, women, or many leaders rule.

155.s:
rajasvalādipatitair na bhāṣeta keśavaṃ smaret /
nāsaṃvṛtamukhaḥ kuryāddhāsaṃ(1) jṛmbhāṃ tathā kṣutaṃ //
155.d:
रजस्वलादिपतितैर् न भाषेत केशवं स्मरेत् /
नासंवृतमुखः कुर्याद्धासं(1) जृम्भां तथा क्षुतं //
155.m: One should not converse with menstruating women or fallen outcasts; one should remember Keśava. / One should not laugh, yawn, or sneeze without covering one's mouth.

155.s:
prabhorapyavamanaṃ khadgopayedvacanaṃ budhaḥ /
indriyāṇāṃ nānukūlī vedarodhaṃ na kārayet //
155.d:
प्रभोरप्यवमनं खद्गोपयेद्वचनं बुधः /
इन्द्रियाणां नानुकूली वेदरोधं न कारयेत् //
155.m: Even if the master shows disrespect, a wise man should conceal his speech. / He should not indulge the senses, nor cause obstruction to the Vedas.

155.s:
nopekṣitavyo vyādhiḥ syādripuralpo 'pi(2) bhārgava /
rathyātigaḥ sadācāmet(3) vibhṛyānnāgnivāriṇī //
155.d:
नोपेक्षितव्यो व्याधिः स्याद्रिपुरल्पो ऽपि(2) भार्गव /
रथ्यातिगः सदाचामेत्(3) विभृयान्नाग्निवारिणी //
155.m: A disease should not be ignored, nor an enemy even if small, O descendant of Bhṛgu. / One who crosses a street should always sip water; one should not carry fire and water [together].

155.s:
na huṅkuryācchivaṃ pūjyaṃ pādaṃ pādena nākramet /
pratyakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā kasya cinnāpriyaṃ vadet //
155.d:
न हुङ्कुर्याच्छिवं पूज्यं पादं पादेन नाक्रमेत् /
प्रत्यक्षं वा परोक्षं वा कस्य चिन्नाप्रियं वदेत् //
155.m: One should not utter 'hum' against Śiva or a venerable person; one should not step on foot with foot; / one should not speak unpleasant words to anyone, whether directly or behind their back.

155.s:
vedaśāstranarendrarṣidevanindāṃ vivarjayet /
strīṇāmīrṣā(4) na kartavyā triśvāsantāsu varjayet //
155.d:
वेदशास्त्रनरेन्द्रर्षिदेवनिन्दां विवर्जयेत् /
स्त्रीणामीर्षा(4) न कर्तव्या त्रिश्वासन्तासु वर्जयेत् //
155.m: One should avoid reviling the Vedas, treatises, kings, sages, and gods. / Jealousy should not be felt toward women; in three situations, one should avoid them.

155.s:
dharmaśrutiṃ devaratiṃ(5) kuryāddharmādi nityaśaḥ(6) /
somasya pūjāṃ janmarkṣe vipradevādipūjanaṃ //
:n
1 kuryāddhāsyamiti kha.. ,ṭa.. ca
2 ripurvatsopi iti ṅa..
3 samācāmediti cha..
4 strīṇāmiccheti ka..
5 devanatimiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca / vedanatimiti kha.. ,cha.. ca
6 bhadraṃ bhadramiti brūyādityādiḥ, kuryāddharmādi nityaśa ity
antaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti
:p 127
155.d:
धर्मश्रुतिं देवरतिं(5) कुर्याद्धर्मादि नित्यशः(6) /
सोमस्य पूजां जन्मर्क्षे विप्रदेवादिपूजनं //
:न्
1 कुर्याद्धास्यमिति ख.. ,ट.. च
2 रिपुर्वत्सोपि इति ङ..
3 समाचामेदिति छ..
4 स्त्रीणामिच्छेति क..
5 देवनतिमिति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च / वेदनतिमिति ख.. ,छ.. च
6 भद्रं भद्रमिति ब्रूयादित्यादिः, कुर्याद्धर्मादि नित्यश इत्य्
अन्तः पाठः झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 127
155.m:
One should always listen to dharma, take delight in the gods, and practice dharma and the like daily; / one should worship the Moon, and worship brāhmaṇas, gods, and the like on one's birth asterism.
:n
1 'kuryāddhāsyam' in kha and ṭa.
2 'ripur vatsopi' in ṅa.
3 'samācāmet' in cha.
4 "strīṇāmiccha" in manuscript ka.
5 "devanatim" in ga, gha, ṅa, ña, and ṭa; / "vedanatim" in kha and cha.
6 The reading beginning with "bhadraṃ bhadramiti brūyāt" and ending with "kuryāddharmādi nityaśaḥ" is absent in manuscript jha. / [Page 127]

155.s:
ṣaṣṭhīcaturdaśyaṣṭamyāmabhyaṅgaṃ varjayettathā /
dūrādgṛhān mūtraviṣṭhe nottamaivairamācaret //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe ācārādhyāyo nāma
pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
dravyacuddhiḥ
155.d:
षष्ठीचतुर्दश्यष्टम्यामभ्यङ्गं वर्जयेत्तथा /
दूराद्गृहान् मूत्रविष्ठे नोत्तमैवैरमाचरेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे आचाराध्यायो नाम
पञ्चपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ षट्पञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
द्रव्यचुद्धिः
155.m:
Likewise, one should avoid anointing oneself with oil on the sixth, fourteenth, and eighth [tithis]. / One should pass urine and feces far from the house, and not practice enmity against superiors.
Thus ends the one hundred fifty-fifth chapter, titled "Proper Conduct", in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now begins the one hundred fifty-sixth chapter.
Purification of Materials

156.s:
puṣkara uvāca
dravyaśuddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi punaḥpākena mṛṇmayaṃ /
śuddhyen mūtrapurīṣādyaiḥ spṛṣṭāmraṃ suvarṇakaṃ //
156.d:
पुष्कर उवाच
द्रव्यशुद्धिं प्रवक्ष्यामि पुनःपाकेन मृण्मयं /
शुद्ध्येन् मूत्रपुरीषाद्यैः स्पृष्टाम्रं सुवर्णकं //
156.m: Puṣkara said: / I shall explain the purification of materials. An earthenware vessel is purified by rebaking. / Gold touched by urine, feces, and the like, [is purified by melting],

156.s:
āvartitañcānyathā tu vāriṇāmllena tāmrakaṃ /
kṣāreṇa kāṃsyalohānāṃ muktādeḥ kṣālanena tu //
156.d:
आवर्तितञ्चान्यथा तु वारिणाम्ल्लेन ताम्रकं /
क्षारेण कांस्यलोहानां मुक्तादेः क्षालनेन तु //
156.m: and by being remelted. Otherwise, copper is purified with acid water, / bell-metal and iron with alkaline ash, and pearls and the like with washing.

156.s:
abjānāṃ(1) caiva bhāṇḍānāṃ sarvasyāśmamayasya ca /
śākarajjumūlaphalavaidalānāṃ tathaiva ca //
156.d:
अब्जानां(1) चैव भाण्डानां सर्वस्याश्ममयस्य च /
शाकरज्जुमूलफलवैदलानां तथैव च //
156.m: And [the purification] of lotus-derived vessels and everything made of stone, / and likewise of vegetables, ropes, roots, fruits, and split-reed items,

156.s:
mārjanādyajñapātrāṇāṃ pāṇinā yajñakarmaṇi /
uṣṇāmbunā sasnehānāṃ śuddhiḥ sammārjanādgṛhe //
:n
1 duṣṭānāmiti ṭa..
:p 128
156.d:
मार्जनाद्यज्ञपात्राणां पाणिना यज्ञकर्मणि /
उष्णाम्बुना सस्नेहानां शुद्धिः सम्मार्जनाद्गृहे //
:न्
1 दुष्टानामिति ट..
:प् 128
156.m:
is by wiping; of sacrificial vessels, by the hand during the sacrificial rite; / of oily objects, with hot water; and in the house, purity is achieved by sweeping.
[Note]
1 "duṣṭānām" in ṭa. / [Page 128]

156.s:
śodhanānmrakṣaṇādvastre(1) mṛttikādbhirviśodhanaṃ /
bahuvastre prokṣaṇācca dāravāṇāñca takṣaṇāt //
156.d:
शोधनान्म्रक्षणाद्वस्त्रे(1) मृत्तिकाद्भिर्विशोधनं /
बहुवस्त्रे प्रोक्षणाच्च दारवाणाञ्च तक्षणात् //
156.m: Purification of cloth is by cleansing or washing with earth and water; / for a large amount of cloth, by sprinkling; and for wooden objects, by planing.

156.s:
prokṣaṇāt saṃhatānāntu dravāṇāñca tathotplavāt /
śayanāsanayānānāṃ śūrpasya śakaṭasya ca //
156.d:
प्रोक्षणात् संहतानान्तु द्रवाणाञ्च तथोत्प्लवात् /
शयनासनयानानां शूर्पस्य शकटस्य च //
156.m: Solid objects [in large amounts] are purified by sprinkling, and liquids by skimming off. / Of beds, seats, vehicles, winnowing baskets, and carts,

156.s:
śuddhiḥ samprokṣaṇāj jñeyā palālendhanayos tathā /
śuddhārthakānāṅkalkena śṛṅgadantamayasya ca //
156.d:
शुद्धिः सम्प्रोक्षणाज् ज्ञेया पलालेन्धनयोस् तथा /
शुद्धार्थकानाङ्कल्केन शृङ्गदन्तमयस्य च //
156.m: purification should be known to be by sprinkling; likewise of straw and firewood. / Items meant for purification [are cleaned] with paste; of horn and ivory items,

156.s:
gobālaiḥ palapātrāṇāmasthnāṃ syācchṛṅgavattathā /
niryāsānāṃ guḍānāñca lavaṇānāṃ ca śoṣaṇāt //
156.d:
गोबालैः पलपात्राणामस्थ्नां स्याच्छृङ्गवत्तथा /
निर्यासानां गुडानाञ्च लवणानां च शोषणात् //
156.m: and of meat vessels, [purification is] by cow hair; of bones, it is like horn. / Of resins, jaggery, and salts, [it is] by drying.

156.s:
kuśumbhakusumānāñca ūrṇākārpāsayos tathā /
śuddhannadīgataṃ toyaṃ puṇyantadvat prasāritaṃ //
156.d:
कुशुम्भकुसुमानाञ्च ऊर्णाकार्पासयोस् तथा /
शुद्धन्नदीगतं तोयं पुण्यन्तद्वत् प्रसारितं //
156.m: And likewise of safflower blossoms, wool, and cotton. / Water located in a river is pure, and holy likewise when drawn out.

156.s:
mukhavarjañca gauḥ śuddhā śuddhamaśvājayormukhaṃ /
nārīṇāñcaiva vatsānāṃ śakunīnāṃ śuno mukhaṃ //
156.d:
मुखवर्जञ्च गौः शुद्धा शुद्धमश्वाजयोर्मुखं /
नारीणाञ्चैव वत्सानां शकुनीनां शुनो मुखं //
156.m: A cow is pure except for its mouth; the mouth of a horse and a goat is pure. / The mouth of women, calves, birds, and dogs,

156.s:
mukhaiḥ prasravaṇe vṛtte mṛgayāyāṃ sadā śuci /
bhuktvā kṣutvā tathā suptvā pītvā cāmbho vigāhya ca //
156.d:
मुखैः प्रस्रवणे वृत्ते मृगयायां सदा शुचि /
भुक्त्वा क्षुत्वा तथा सुप्त्वा पीत्वा चाम्भो विगाह्य च //
156.m: when their mouths are engaged in catching prey during hunting, is always pure. / Having eaten, sneezed, slept, drunk water, bathed,

156.s:
rathyāmākramya cācāmedvāso viparidhāya ca /
mārjāraś caṅkramācchuddhaś caturythe 'hni rajasvalā //
156.d:
रथ्यामाक्रम्य चाचामेद्वासो विपरिधाय च /
मार्जारश् चङ्क्रमाच्छुद्धश् चतुर्य्थे ऽह्नि रजस्वला //
156.m: walked upon a public street, and changed one's garment, one should sip water. / A cat is pure while walking around. A menstruating woman [becomes pure] on the fourth day;

156.s:
snātā strī pañcame yogyā daive pitrye ca karmaṇi /
pañcāpāne daśaikasminnubhayoḥ sapta mṛttikāḥ //
156.d:
स्नाता स्त्री पञ्चमे योग्या दैवे पित्र्ये च कर्मणि /
पञ्चापाने दशैकस्मिन्नुभयोः सप्त मृत्तिकाः //
156.m: having bathed on the fifth day, the woman is fit for rites to the gods and ancestors. / Five [applications of] clay to the anus, ten to the left hand, and seven to both hands [are prescribed].

156.s:
ekāṃ liṅge mṛdaṃ dadyāt karayostridvimṛttikāḥ /
brahmacārivanasthānāṃ yatīnāñca caturguṇaṃ //
156.d:
एकां लिङ्गे मृदं दद्यात् करयोस्त्रिद्विमृत्तिकाः /
ब्रह्मचारिवनस्थानां यतीनाञ्च चतुर्गुणं //
156.m: One should apply clay once to the penis, and three and two times to both hands. / For celibate students, forest hermits, and ascetics, it is fourfold.

156.s:
śrīphalair aṃśupaṭṭānāṃ kṣaumāṇāṅgaurasarṣapaiḥ /
:n
1 śodhanābhyukṣaṇādvastre iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
:p 129
śuddhiḥ paryukṣya toyena mṛgalomnāṃ prakīrtitā //
156.d:
श्रीफलैर् अंशुपट्टानां क्षौमाणाङ्गौरसर्षपैः /
:न्
1 शोधनाभ्युक्षणाद्वस्त्रे इति घ.. , ङ.. च
:प् 129
शुद्धिः पर्युक्ष्य तोयेन मृगलोम्नां प्रकीर्तिता //
156.m:
[Purification] of silk cloth is with bilva fruits; of linen cloth, with white mustard seeds.
[Note]
1 "śodhanābhyukṣaṇādvastre" in gha and ṅa. / [Page 129]
Purification of deer hair is declared to be by sprinkling with water.

156.s:
puṣpāṇāñca phalānāñca prokṣaṇājjalato 'khilaṃ /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe dravyaśuddhirnāma
ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha saptapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
śāvāśaucādiḥ
156.d:
पुष्पाणाञ्च फलानाञ्च प्रोक्षणाज्जलतो ऽखिलं /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे द्रव्यशुद्धिर्नाम
षट्पञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ सप्तपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
शावाशौचादिः
156.m:
The entire [purity] of flowers and fruits is through sprinkling with water.
Thus ends the one hundred fifty-sixth chapter, titled "Purification of Materials", in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now begins the one hundred fifty-seventh chapter.
Impurity on Death and Childbirth

157.s:
puṣkara uvāca
pretaśuddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi sūtikāśudhhimeva ca /
daśāhaṃ śāvamāśaucaṃ sapiṇdeṣu vidhīyate //
157.d:
पुष्कर उवाच
प्रेतशुद्धिं प्रवक्ष्यामि सूतिकाशुध्हिमेव च /
दशाहं शावमाशौचं सपिण्देषु विधीयते //
157.m: Puṣkara said: / I shall explain the purification regarding a deceased person and the purification regarding childbirth. / A ten-day ritual impurity on death is prescribed among sapiṇḍa relatives,

157.s:
janane ca tathā śuddhirbrāhmaṇānāṃ bhṛgūttama /
dvādaśāhena rājanyaḥ pakṣādvaiśyo 'tha māsataḥ //
157.d:
जनने च तथा शुद्धिर्ब्राह्मणानां भृगूत्तम /
द्वादशाहेन राजन्यः पक्षाद्वैश्यो ऽथ मासतः //
157.m: and purification occurs in the same way on childbirth for Brahmins, O best of the Bhṛgus. / A kṣatriya [becomes pure] through twelve days, a vaiśya through a fortnight, and a śūdra

157.s:
śūdro 'nulomato dāse svāmitulyantvaśaucakaṃ /
ṣaṭbhistribhirathaikena kṣatraviṭśūdrayoniṣu //
157.d:
शूद्रो ऽनुलोमतो दासे स्वामितुल्यन्त्वशौचकं /
षट्भिस्त्रिभिरथैकेन क्षत्रविट्शूद्रयोनिषु //
157.m: through a month. For a servant of the anuloma order, the ritual impurity is equal to the master's. / By six, three, and one [day], respectively, [in the case of relations] born of the womb of a kṣatriya, vaiśya, and śūdra,

157.s:
brāhmaṇaḥ śuddhimāpnoti kṣatriyastu tathaiva ca /
viṭśūdrayoneḥ śuddhiḥ syāt kramāt paraśurāmaka //
157.d:
ब्राह्मणः शुद्धिमाप्नोति क्षत्रियस्तु तथैव च /
विट्शूद्रयोनेः शुद्धिः स्यात् क्रमात् परशुरामक //
157.m: a Brahmin attains purity; and so does a kṣatriya. / Purity for one born from the womb of a vaiśya and śūdra takes place in order, O Paraśurāma,

157.s:
ṣaḍrātreṇa trirātreṇa ṣaḍbhiḥ śūdre tathā viśaḥ /
:p 130
ādantajananāt sadya ācūḍānnaiśikī śrutiḥ(1) //
157.d:
षड्रात्रेण त्रिरात्रेण षड्भिः शूद्रे तथा विशः /
:प् 130
आदन्तजननात् सद्य आचूडान्नैशिकी श्रुतिः(1) //
157.m:
by six nights and three nights; likewise, for a vaiśya in the case of a śūdra, by six [nights].
[Page 130]
Up to the eruption of teeth, [purification is] immediate; up to tonsure, a single night's [impurity] is the traditional teaching.

157.s:
trirātramāvratādeśāddaśarātramataḥ paraṃ /
ūnatraivārṣike śūdre pañcāhācchuddhiriṣyate //
157.d:
त्रिरात्रमाव्रतादेशाद्दशरात्रमतः परं /
ऊनत्रैवार्षिके शूद्रे पञ्चाहाच्छुद्धिरिष्यते //
157.m: Three nights [of impurity] up to the investiture with vows; beyond that, ten nights. / For a śūdra under three years of age, purity is recognized after five days.

157.s:
dvādaśāhene śuddhiḥ syādatīte vatsaratraye /
gataiḥ saṃvatsaraiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ śuddhirmāsena kīrtitā //
157.d:
द्वादशाहेने शुद्धिः स्यादतीते वत्सरत्रये /
गतैः संवत्सरैः षड्भिः शुद्धिर्मासेन कीर्तिता //
157.m: When three years have passed, purity occurs through twelve days. / When six years have elapsed, purity is proclaimed to be after one month.

157.s:
strīṇāmakṛtacūḍānāṃ viśuddhir naiśikī smṛtā /
tathā ca kṛtacuḍānāṃ tryahācchuddhyanti bāndhavāḥ //
157.d:
स्त्रीणामकृतचूडानां विशुद्धिर् नैशिकी स्मृता /
तथा च कृतचुडानां त्र्यहाच्छुद्ध्यन्ति बान्धवाः //
157.m: For girls who have not undergone tonsure, purification is remembered to be for a single night; / and for those whose tonsure has been performed, the relatives are purified after three days.

157.s:
vivāhitāsu nāśaucaṃ pitṛpakṣe vidhīyate /
piturgṛhe prasūtānāṃ viśuddhir naiśikī smṛtā //
157.d:
विवाहितासु नाशौचं पितृपक्षे विधीयते /
पितुर्गृहे प्रसूतानां विशुद्धिर् नैशिकी स्मृता //
157.m: For married women, no ritual impurity is ordained on the father's side. / For those who give birth in their father's house, purification is remembered to be for a single night.

157.s:
sūtikā daśarātreṇa śuddhimāpnoti nānyathā /
vivāhitā hi cet kanyā mriyate pitṛveśmani //
157.d:
सूतिका दशरात्रेण शुद्धिमाप्नोति नान्यथा /
विवाहिता हि चेत् कन्या म्रियते पितृवेश्मनि //
157.m: A woman who has given birth attains purity in ten nights, not otherwise. / If a married maiden dies in her father's home,

157.s:
tasyāstrirātrācchuddhyanti bāndhavā nātra saṃśayaḥ /
samānaṃ labdhaśaucantu prathamena samāpayet //
157.d:
तस्यास्त्रिरात्राच्छुद्ध्यन्ति बान्धवा नात्र संशयः /
समानं लब्धशौचन्तु प्रथमेन समापयेत् //
157.m: her relatives are purified after three nights; of this there is no doubt. / However, when an equal [period of] ritual impurity is incurred, one completes it with the first.

157.s:
asamānaṃ dvitīyena dharmarājavaco yathā /
deśāntarasthaḥ śrutvā tu kulyāṇāṃ maraṇodbhavau //
157.d:
असमानं द्वितीयेन धर्मराजवचो यथा /
देशान्तरस्थः श्रुत्वा तु कुल्याणां मरणोद्भवौ //
157.m: When it is unequal, [one completes it] with the second, according to the word of Dharmarāja. / If a person residing in another region hears of the death or birth of relatives,

157.s:
yaccheṣaṃ daśarātrasya tāvadevaśucirbhavet /
atīte daśarātre tu trirātramaśucirbhavet //
157.d:
यच्छेषं दशरात्रस्य तावदेवशुचिर्भवेत् /
अतीते दशरात्रे तु त्रिरात्रमशुचिर्भवेत् //
157.m: he remains impure for whatever is left of the ten nights. / But when the ten nights have passed, he is impure for three nights.

157.s:
tathā saṃvatsare 'tīte snāta eva viśuddhyati /
mātāmahe tathātīte ācārye ca tathā mṛte //
157.d:
तथा संवत्सरे ऽतीते स्नात एव विशुद्ध्यति /
मातामहे तथातीते आचार्ये च तथा मृते //
157.m: Likewise, when a year has passed, he is purified immediately upon bathing. / Likewise, when a maternal grandfather passes away, or when a teacher dies,

157.s:
rātribhirmāsatulyābhirgarbhasrāve viśodhanaṃ /
sapiṇde brāhmaṇe varṇāḥ sarva evāviśeṣataḥ //
:n
1 ācaḍānnaiśikī tatheti ṭa..
:p 131
157.d:
रात्रिभिर्मासतुल्याभिर्गर्भस्रावे विशोधनं /
सपिण्दे ब्राह्मणे वर्णाः सर्व एवाविशेषतः //
:न्
1 आचडान्नैशिकी तथेति ट..
:प् 131
157.m:
purification in the case of a miscarriage is by a number of nights equal to the months [of gestation]. / In the case of a Brahmin sapiṇḍa, all classes without distinction
[Note]
1 "ācaḍānnaiśikī tathā" in ṭa. / [Page 131]

157.s:
daśarātreṇa śuddhyanti dvādaśāhena bhūmipaḥ /
vaiśyāḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdrā māsena bhārgava //
157.d:
दशरात्रेण शुद्ध्यन्ति द्वादशाहेन भूमिपः /
वैश्याः पञ्चदशाहेन शूद्रा मासेन भार्गव //
157.m: are purified in ten nights; a king in twelve days; / vaiśyas in fifteen days; and śūdras in a month, O Bhārgava.

157.s:
ucchiṣṭasannidhāvekaṃ tathā piṇḍaṃ nivedayet /
kīrtayecca tathā tasya namagotre samāhitaḥ //
157.d:
उच्छिष्टसन्निधावेकं तथा पिण्डं निवेदयेत् /
कीर्तयेच्च तथा तस्य नमगोत्रे समाहितः //
157.m: One should also offer a piṇḍa in the vicinity of the food leavings, / and, concentrated in mind, pronounce the name and gotra of the deceased.

157.s:
bhuktavatsu dvijendreṣu pūjiteṣu dhanena ca(1) /
visṛṣṭākṣatatoyeṣu gotranāmānukīrtanaiḥ //
157.d:
भुक्तवत्सु द्विजेन्द्रेषु पूजितेषु धनेन च(1) /
विसृष्टाक्षततोयेषु गोत्रनामानुकीर्तनैः //
157.m: When the foremost twice-born have eaten, have been honored with wealth, / and have dismissed the unbroken rice and water with the recitation of the gotra and name,

157.s:
caturaṅgulavistāraṃ tatkhātantāvadantaraṃ /
vitastidīrghaṃ kartavyaṃ vikarṣūṇāṃ tathā trayaṃ //
157.d:
चतुरङ्गुलविस्तारं तत्खातन्तावदन्तरं /
वितस्तिदीर्घं कर्तव्यं विकर्षूणां तथा त्रयं //
157.m: three furrows are to be made, each four finger-breadths wide, / with that much space between them, and one span long.

157.s:
vikarṣūṇāṃ samīpe ca jvālayej jvalanatrayaṃ /
somāya vahnaye rāma yamāya ca samāsataḥ //
157.d:
विकर्षूणां समीपे च ज्वालयेज् ज्वलनत्रयं /
सोमाय वह्नये राम यमाय च समासतः //
157.m: Near the furrows, one should ignite three fires. / In brief, O Rāma, for Soma, Agni, and Yama,

157.s:
juhuyādāhutīḥ samyak sarvatraiva catustrayaḥ /
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuryāt prāgvadeva pṛthak pṛthak //
157.d:
जुहुयादाहुतीः सम्यक् सर्वत्रैव चतुस्त्रयः /
पिण्डनिर्वपणं कुर्यात् प्राग्वदेव पृथक् पृथक् //
157.m: one should properly offer oblations, three or four in every case. / One should make the offering of piṇḍas separately, just as before.

157.s:
annena dadhnā madhunā tathā māṃsena pūrayet /
madhye cedadhimāsaḥ syāt kuryādabhyadhikantu tat //
157.d:
अन्नेन दध्ना मधुना तथा मांसेन पूरयेत् /
मध्ये चेदधिमासः स्यात् कुर्यादभ्यधिकन्तु तत् //
157.m: One should fill it with cooked rice, curd, honey, and meat. / If an intercalary month occurs in the middle, one should perform that additionally.

157.s:
athavā dvādaśāhena sarvametat samāpayet /
saṃvatsarasya madhye ca yadi syādadhimāsakaḥ //
157.d:
अथवा द्वादशाहेन सर्वमेतत् समापयेत् /
संवत्सरस्य मध्ये च यदि स्यादधिमासकः //
157.m: Or else one should conclude all of this within twelve days, / even if an intercalary month occurs in the middle of the year.

157.s:
tadā dvādaśake śrāddhe kāryaṃ tadadhikaṃ bhavet /
saṃvatsare samāpte tu śrāddhaṃ śrāddhavadācaret //
157.d:
तदा द्वादशके श्राद्धे कार्यं तदधिकं भवेत् /
संवत्सरे समाप्ते तु श्राद्धं श्राद्धवदाचरेत् //
157.m:
Then, during the twelfth ancestral rite, that extra [rite] should be performed.
When the year has ended, he should perform the ancestral rite just like an [ordinary] ancestral rite.

157.s:
pretāya tata ūrdhavaṃ ca tasyaiva puruṣatraye /
piṇḍān vinirvapettadvaccaturastu samāhitaḥ //
157.d:
प्रेताय तत ऊर्धवं च तस्यैव पुरुषत्रये /
पिण्डान् विनिर्वपेत्तद्वच्चतुरस्तु समाहितः //
157.m:
Thereafter, for the deceased and for three generations of his [ancestors],
he should carefully offer four balls of food in the same manner.

157.s:
sampūjya datvā pṛthivī samānā iti cāpyatha /
:n
1 dhaneṣu ceti ka.. , kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
:p 132
yojayet pretapiṇḍaṃ tu piṇḍeṣvanyeṣu bhārgava //
157.d:
सम्पूज्य दत्वा पृथिवी समाना इति चाप्यथ /
:न्
1 धनेषु चेति क.. , ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
:प् 132
योजयेत् प्रेतपिण्डं तु पिण्डेष्वन्येषु भार्गव //
157.m:
Having worshipped, having given, and reciting "May the earth be equal…" and so on,
[Footnote]
1. "dhaneṣu ca" in manuscripts ka, kha, gha, ṅa, cha, ja, and ña.
[Page] 132
he should join the ball of food for the deceased with the other balls of food, O descendant of Bhṛgu.

157.s:
pretapātraṃ ca pātreṣu tathaiva viniyojayet /
pṛthak pṛthak prakartavyaṃ karmaitat karmapātrake //
157.d:
प्रेतपात्रं च पात्रेषु तथैव विनियोजयेत् /
पृथक् पृथक् प्रकर्तव्यं कर्मैतत् कर्मपात्रके //
157.m:
And he should likewise join the vessel of the deceased with the [ancestral] vessels.
This rite should be performed separately in the ritual vessel.

157.s:
mantravarjamidaṃ karma śūdrasya tu vidhīyate /
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ strīṇāṃ kāryamevaṃ tadā bhavet(1) //
157.d:
मन्त्रवर्जमिदं कर्म शूद्रस्य तु विधीयते /
सपिण्डीकरणं स्त्रीणां कार्यमेवं तदा भवेत्(1) //
157.m:
This rite is prescribed for a Śūdra without mantras.
The sapindisation of women should then be performed in this manner.

157.s:
śrāddhaṃ kuryācca pratyabdaṃ prete kumbhānnamabdakaṃ /
gaṅgāyāḥ sikatā dhārā yathā varṣati vāsave //
157.d:
श्राद्धं कुर्याच्च प्रत्यब्दं प्रेते कुम्भान्नमब्दकं /
गङ्गायाः सिकता धारा यथा वर्षति वासवे //
157.m:
He should perform the ancestral rite every year, and for a full year provide a pot of water and food for the deceased.
Just as the grains of sand of the Gaṅgā, or streams of water when Indra rains,

157.s:
śakyā gaṇayituṃ loke natvatītāḥ pitāmahāḥ /
kāle satatage sthairyaṃ nāsti tasmāt kriyāṃ caret //
157.d:
शक्या गणयितुं लोके नत्वतीताः पितामहाः /
काले सततगे स्थैर्यं नास्ति तस्मात् क्रियां चरेत् //
157.m:
are capable of being counted in the world, but not departed ancestors;
there is no permanence in time which constantly moves; therefore one should perform the rites.

157.s:
devatve yātanāsthāne pretaḥ śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ labhet /
nopakuryānnaraḥ śocan pretasyātmana eva vā //
157.d:
देवत्वे यातनास्थाने प्रेतः श्राद्धं कृतं लभेत् /
नोपकुर्यान्नरः शोचन् प्रेतस्यात्मन एव वा //
157.m:
Whether in godhead or in a place of torment, the deceased receives what is performed in the ancestral rite.
A person achieves nothing by lamenting, either for the deceased or for oneself.

157.s:
bhṛgvagnipāśakāmbhobhirmṛtānāmātmaghātināṃ /
patitānāṃ ca nāśaucaṃ vidyucchastrahatāś ca ye //
157.d:
भृग्वग्निपाशकाम्भोभिर्मृतानामात्मघातिनां /
पतितानां च नाशौचं विद्युच्छस्त्रहताश् च ये //
157.m:
There is no ritual impurity for suicides who died by falling from a precipice, by fire, by a noose, or by water,
nor for the degraded, or those killed by lightning or weapons.

157.s:
yatibratibrahmacārinṛpakārukadīkṣitāḥ /
rājājñākāriṇo(2) ye ca snāyādvai pretagāmyapi //
157.d:
यतिब्रतिब्रह्मचारिनृपकारुकदीक्षिताः /
राजाज्ञाकारिणो(2) ये च स्नायाद्वै प्रेतगाम्यपि //
157.m:
Renunciants, vow-holders, celibate students, kings, artisans, and initiated persons,
and those who execute the king's orders [incur no ritual impurity]; but one who attends a corpse should certainly bathe.

157.s:
maithune kaṭadhūme ca sadyaḥ snānaṃ vidhīyate /
dvijaṃ na nirharet(3) pretaṃ śūdreṇa tu kathañcana //
157.d:
मैथुने कटधूमे च सद्यः स्नानं विधीयते /
द्विजं न निर्हरेत्(3) प्रेतं शूद्रेण तु कथञ्चन //
157.m:
Immediate bathing is prescribed after sexual intercourse and from the smoke of a funeral pyre.
A twice-born corpse must never be carried out by a Śūdra,

157.s:
na ca śūdraṃ dvijenāpi tayordoṣo hi jāyate(4) /
anāthaviprapretasya vahanāt svaragalokabhāk //
:n
1 kāryameva tathā bhavediti cha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca / kāryametattathā bhavediti
jha..
2 rājājñākārakā iti ṭa..
3 na nirdahediti kha..
4 tayordoṣo 'bhijāyate iti ṅa..
:p 133
157.d:
न च शूद्रं द्विजेनापि तयोर्दोषो हि जायते(4) /
अनाथविप्रप्रेतस्य वहनात् स्वरगलोकभाक् //
:न्
1 कार्यमेव तथा भवेदिति छ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. च / कार्यमेतत्तथा भवेदिति
झ..
2 राजाज्ञाकारका इति ट..
3 न निर्दहेदिति ख..
4 तयोर्दोषो ऽभिजायते इति ङ..
:प् 133
157.m:
nor a Śūdra by a twice-born, for a fault is indeed incurred by both of them.
By carrying the corpse of an unprotected Brahmin, one attains the heavenly world.
[Footnote]
1. "kāryameva tathā bhavet" in cha, ṅa, and ña; / "kāryametattathā bhavet" in jha.
2. "rājājñākārakāḥ" in ṭa.
3. "na nirdahet" in kha.
4. "tayordoṣo 'bhijāyate" in ṅa.
[Page] 133

157.s:
saṅgrāme jayamāpnoti prete 'nāthe ca kāṣṭhadaḥ /
saṅkalpya bāndhavaṃ pretamapasavyena tāṃ citiṃ //
157.d:
सङ्ग्रामे जयमाप्नोति प्रेते ऽनाथे च काष्ठदः /
सङ्कल्प्य बान्धवं प्रेतमपसव्येन तां चितिं //
157.m:
He who provides firewood for an unprotected deceased person wins victory in battle.
Having intended [the rite] for the deceased relative, [circumambulating] that pyre to the left,

157.s:
parikramya tataḥ snānaṃ kuryuḥ sarve savāsasaḥ /
pretāya ca tathā dadyustrīṃstrīṃś caivodakāñjalīn //
157.d:
परिक्रम्य ततः स्नानं कुर्युः सर्वे सवाससः /
प्रेताय च तथा दद्युस्त्रींस्त्रींश् चैवोदकाञ्जलीन् //
157.m:
and walking around it, they all should then bathe along with their clothes,
and they should likewise offer three handfuls of water each to the deceased.

157.s:
dvāryaśmani padaṃ datvā praviśeyus tathā gṛhaṃ /
akṣatānnikṣipedvahnau nimbapatraṃ vidaśya ca //
157.d:
द्वार्यश्मनि पदं दत्वा प्रविशेयुस् तथा गृहं /
अक्षतान्निक्षिपेद्वह्नौ निम्बपत्रं विदश्य च //
157.m:
Placing a foot upon a stone at the doorway, they should then enter the house;
and having bitten a neem leaf, one should throw unbroken grains into the fire.

157.s:
pṛthak śayīran bhūmau ca krītalabdhāśano bhavet /
ekaḥ piṇdo daśāhe tu śmaśrukarmakaraḥ śuciḥ //
157.d:
पृथक् शयीरन् भूमौ च क्रीतलब्धाशनो भवेत् /
एकः पिण्दो दशाहे तु श्मश्रुकर्मकरः शुचिः //
157.m:
They should sleep separately on the ground, and one should eat food that was bought or obtained [unasked].
One ball of food [is offered] during the ten days; shaving the hair and beard, he becomes pure.

157.s:
siddhārthakaistilair vidvān majjedvāsoparaṃ dadhat(1) /
ajātadante tanaye śiśau garbhasrute tathā //
157.d:
सिद्धार्थकैस्तिलैर् विद्वान् मज्जेद्वासोपरं दधत्(1) /
अजातदन्ते तनये शिशौ गर्भस्रुते तथा //
157.m:
The wise man should bathe with white mustard and sesame seeds, wearing another garment.
When a son dies whose teeth have not erupted, or an infant, or in the case of a miscarriage,

157.s:
kāryo naivāgnisaṃskāro naiva cāsyodakakriyā /
caturthe ca dinekāryas tathāsthnāṃ caiva sañcayaḥ //
157.d:
कार्यो नैवाग्निसंस्कारो नैव चास्योदकक्रिया /
चतुर्थे च दिनेकार्यस् तथास्थ्नां चैव सञ्चयः //
157.m:
cremation is not to be performed, nor the rite of offering water for him.
And on the fourth day, the collection of bones should be performed.

157.s:
asthisañcayanādūrdhvamaṅgasparśo vidhīyate //42//
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe śāvāśaucaṃ nāma
saptapañcāśadādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athāṣṭapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
srāvādyaśaucaṃ
157.d:
अस्थिसञ्चयनादूर्ध्वमङ्गस्पर्शो विधीयते //42//
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे शावाशौचं नाम
सप्तपञ्चाशदाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथाष्टपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
स्रावाद्यशौचं
157.m:
Touching of limbs is prescribed after the collection of the bones. //42
Thus in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and fifty-seventh chapter, entitled “Ritual Impurity from Death”.
Now, the one hundred and fifty-eighth chapter.
Ritual Impurity from Miscarriage and the Like
